title: Screen Options Schema
description: Generate a screen component in src/app/screens with .screen file names.

project.description: The name of the project where the screen should be added.

name.description: The name for the new screen.
name.x-prompt: What name would you like to use for the screen?

displayBlock.description: Add :host { display: block; } to the screen stylesheet.

inlineStyle.description: Include styles directly in the TypeScript file.

inlineTemplate.description: Include the template directly in the TypeScript file.

prefix.description: A prefix to add to the generated selector.

addTypeToClassName.description: Append Screen to the generated class name.

flat.description: Create the screen files directly in src/app/screens.

skipImport.description: Do not automatically import the screen into an NgModule.

selector.description: The HTML selector to use for the screen.

module.description: The NgModule where the screen should be declared.

export.description: Export the screen from the specified NgModule.

exportDefault.description: Use a default export for the screen class.
